subject: Choosing x/y lim for each facet in grid

messages.author: ca5dd90d5422193f
messages.subject: Choosing x/y lim for each facet in grid
parts:
Hi folks,

From the Dec '09/Jan '10 post "Setting x/y lim in facet_grid Options "
I see that Hadley may have been working on allowing different x/y
limits to be applied to each facet independently.

Any idea if this has since been included? I've had a look around the
docs in github, but haven't seen anything.

Thanks kindly,

Tommy

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Choosing x/y lim for each facet in grid
parts:
Hi,

At the moment, it has not been implemented.

Here is a testbed to set limits for coordinate in each facet panel,
but will not be included in ggplot2 main stream in that form.
https://github.com/kohske/ggplot2/commits/feature/coord-manual-lim

Another way is to set the limits on data like this:

# limits of mpg for each am
lims <- list(`0` = c(10, 25), `1` = c(15, 30))
mtcars2 <- ddply(mtcars, .(am),
function(x) {
lim <- lims[[paste(x$am[1])]]
subset(x, lim[1] < mpg & mpg < lim[2])
})

ggplot(mtcars2, aes(cyl, mpg)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~am, scales
= "free_y")


--
